identity.title: Research-Paper Forward Decision & Evidence Loop
identity.objective: One finite offline restart-safe operator: pre-frozen research-only paper plan plus time-ordered candidates -> native WP173 research-paper decisions, an append-only hash-chained full-funnel occurrence ledger reconciled with the unchanged native snapshot, truthful closed/unsettled outcome reporting and optional FakeHermesBackend PERFORMANCE_UPDATE only for a matching StrategyVersion; no src change, product network, provider, scheduler, execution or live authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert the exact seven-path diff. The operator, tests, contract, deferred entry, status and prompt/spec disappear; native WP173, WP169, Hermes, lifecycle and all operator run directories outside the repository are unaffected.

api_matrix.reason: One additive finite operator and its evidence contract; every native API is reused unchanged.

items.after: Explicit-path finite run-once/resume, cold verify and optional offline feedback over operator-named run directories.
items.compatibility_requirement: No default paths, network, provider, daemon, schedule, retries under new identity, or repository writes.

items.surface: WP173 PaperEngine/PaperStore/runtime, WP169 Wp169ReadOnlyTail, paper_performance_bridge, autonomous_feedback, strategy_lifecycle

semantic_fields.reason: Ten bounded operator semantics with honest typed outcomes.

items.condition: Native RUNTIME readiness IMPLEMENTATION_READY on the exact seven-path scope, simulated historical changed-path/status guards need no eighth path, synthetic closure proof passed on the frozen base.

items.expected_result: Plan hash is the first ledger entry before any decision; later frozen_at, altered plan on rerun and reserved/OOS refs are rejected; binding flags stay research-only with zero capital.
Future source, equal-time book, stale or gapped asset book, wrong market and wrong token produce typed NO_TRADE terminals and no native order.
Missing fee config, exponent zero, nonzero maker rebate or bps below rate*10000 give COST_UNKNOWN for every candidate; a valid bound is reported as ESTIMATE.

With a duplicate row: raw rows = unique + suppressed and unique = STARTED = terminals; ATTEMPTED_INTENT incl. RISK_DENIED equals native intent_count and risk_permitted false equals risk_deny_count; an accepted order still OPEN and a PARTIALLY_FILLED order later FILLED or EXPIRED change only as-of counts (summing to order_count, closed part = closed_order_state_counts) while past terminals stay byte-identical.

STARTED precedes engine calls; crash before submit resumes as INTERRUPTED_OR_UNKNOWN; crash after native submit before terminal binds the committed intent once as RECOVERED with no resubmit or double count; duplicate rows before and after restart are suppressed with both equalities holding; external paper head change fails closed.
Owned SELL and authentic winner settlement realize the exact formula P&L; null winner stays pending and UNSETTLED; replay winner is IMPORTED_UNVERIFIED_RESOLUTION; missing marks stay UNKNOWN.

Matching version is ASSESSED via FakeHermesBackend; absent match is FEEDBACK_PENDING_NO_MATCHING_LIFECYCLE with zero calls; stale cutoff and real backend rejected; paper and lifecycle bytes unchanged.
verify recomputes chain, plan hash, snapshot id and funnel without writing; edited ledger line, foreign or altered paper store fail closed.
CLI demands explicit paths and bounds, refuses repository output paths, makes zero socket attempts and contains no loop daemon, sleep, subprocess or network import; WP169 store bytes unchanged.
Report keeps synthetic, WP169, imported and simulated labels distinct, separates realized, unrealized and pending, and carries no edge, OOS, qualification, venue-return or live claim.
